title: Anyone else using IA placeholders to create a visual novel? How to prevent backlash?
author: theonewithcats
selftext:
Hello, guys! These past few months I've been developing a visual novel demo for a story I wrote and I'm really excited about it, but opinions on AI on reddit are wildly negative. I wrote all the story and programmed everything from scratch, and used AI for art and music as a placeholder while I look for studios that might be interested to use my story into an actual game, with actual human-made assets.

  
That being said I really wanted to show it on Reddit for opinions on the story and other matters, but I don't want to be downvoted to oblivion before people even try it. How can I prevent that?
